# Rosalind Penrose

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-forties in Volume 1; forty-five by the time of her marriage  <sub>[v1 c21 P45](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0045), [v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c21 P46](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0046)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mother Rosalind  <sub>[v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosalind is a slender, petite woman with a smooth, youthful complexion, rosy cheeks, sweet lips, and large, gentle, wood-brown eyes dotted with gold. She has charming dimples and thick, wavy, snow-white hair, which she wears in flattering puffs and coils. She has a fondness for youthful, frilly dresses, particularly in cream and rose tones, as well as grey silk shawls.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 c21 P45](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0045), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c27 P6](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0006), [v1 c33 P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009)_

## Personality

Rosalind is an imaginative, romantic, and deeply affectionate woman who adores beauty, poetry, and children. Though somewhat theatrical and dramatic, she possesses a warm, kind heart and a youthful spirit that endears her to others. Behind her cheerful and charming exterior, she harbors a proud, stubborn streak that once caused her immense heartbreak, as well as a sensitive nature that feels loneliness acutely.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 c21 P18](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0018), [v1 c21 P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 c23 P19](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0019), [v1 c23 P20](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0020), [v1 c26 P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 c27 P12](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0012)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and romantic  <sub>[v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 c21 P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053)</sub>
- Proud and stubborn  <sub>[v1 c23 P19](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0019), [v1 c23 P20](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0020)</sub>
- Affectionate toward children  <sub>[v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 c23 P33](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0033)</sub>
- Sensitive to loneliness  <sub>[v1 c21 P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Adept at imaginative play and storytelling  <sub>[v1 c21 P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 c27 P27](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0027)</sub>
- Skillful at gardening and flower cultivation  <sub>[v1 c21 P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To surround herself with love, beauty, and youthful spirit  <sub>[v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015)</sub>
- To reunite with her true love, Stephen Stanhope  <sub>[v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030)</sub>

## History

Rosalind Penrose resided for many years at the picturesque sandstone Echo Cottage in Welby. Having parted from her youthful fiancé, Stephen Stanhope, due to a proud misunderstanding, she remained unmarried and spent her time gardening, playing imaginative games, and hosting pretend tea parties. Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke stumbled upon her cottage while lost, and Rosalind quickly formed a close friendship with Nell, recognizing her as a kindred spirit. Later, Nell introduced Rosalind to Stephen's young son, Cedric Stanhope, whom Rosalind grew to love dearly. When Stephen returned to St. Brendan's Island, Nell helped facilitate a reunion between the former lovers. Reconciling after twenty-five years, Rosalind and Stephen were married late the following summer in the garden of Echo Cottage. After the wedding, she departed with her husband for a trip to the Pacific coast before settling down in Boston with Stephen, Cedric, and her hired girl Belinda, while planning to return to Echo Cottage every summer.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P28](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0028), [v1 c21 P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c27 P27](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0027), [v1 c28 P39](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0039), [v1 c29 P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Born to Mr. and Mrs. Penrose at Echo Cottage in Welby, named after her father's love of lavender  <sub>[v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008)</sub>
- Engaged as a young woman to Stephen Stanhope, but broke it off after a foolish quarrel driven by pride  <sub>[v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P19](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Lived quietly for years at Echo Cottage with a succession of hired young girls, all referred to as 'Belinda'  <sub>[v1 c21 P38](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0038)</sub>

## Quotes

> A few of these people are going to take their departure, but others will come in their place, and I guess the world will keep turning around just the same.  <sub>[v1 c21 P45](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0045)</sub>

> I'm a crabbed, lonesome, crusty old chap, but I feel young again because of something about that little girl . . . and having that sensation repeated once in a while is something I'd like, since it's so pleasant.  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>

> The greatest girl in the world. She's so packed with spirit that it's overflowing.  <sub>[v2 c9 P43](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0043)</sub>
